role: Coherence validation for DriveSnapshot IPC boundary before caching
detail: Validates snapshots from the isolated Drive Engine child process before caching. Core exports: validateDriveSnapshotCoherence (validates bounds, initialization state, totalPressure consistency, and staleness); defensiveCopySnapshot (deep JSON copy with Date restoration). Validation checks: (1) all drive values within DRIVE_RANGE [-10.0, 1.0], (2) not all drives zero post-initialization (crash detection), (3) totalPressure matches computed sum with 0.001 tolerance, (4) snapshot not stale (>5s since last valid, accounting for 1Hz tick rate + jitter). Cold-start sentinel epoch detection prevents false staleness at boot. JSON round-trip Date reconstruction ensures type consistency for consumers.
gotchas: Timestamp serialization via JSON.stringify converts Date to ISO string; code reconstructs it post-deserialize. Staleness check skips when lastValidTimestamp is epoch sentinel (getTime() <= 0). Drive value consistency at IPC boundary is the only crash/hang detection point before cache.
